houseRulesVerification.criteria: Bilingual (Arabic & English), respectful, on-topic, no personal contact, under 60 words each

rules: Questions must be directly related to the current lecture or topic.
Be polite and concise so Mr. Adel and the assistants can respond effectively.
Questions pass through moderation before becoming visible to all students.
Spam, disruptive messages, or sharing personal contacts will lead to suspension.
يجب أن تكون الأسئلة متعلقة مباشرة بموضوع الحصة أو المحاضرة الحالية.
يرجى صياغة السؤال بإيجاز ووضوح لتسهيل الإجابة من قِبل الأستاذ عادل ومساعديه.
الحد الزمني: سؤال واحد كل 15 ثانية كحد أقصى.
تخضع الأسئلة للمراجعة قبل أن تظهر لجميع الطلاب.
يُمنع التكرار أو إرسال أرقام هواتف أو روابط غير مصرح بها.

sampleQuestionsVerification.criteria: 5 sample questions matching English-lesson topics, synthetic prompts without real student PII

questions.body: Can you explain the difference between "used to" and "would" for past habits?
How do we identify the tone of the writer in unseen reading passages?
When does the past perfect continuous take precedence over the simple past perfect?
What is the grammatical rule for subject-verb agreement with collective nouns?
Which transitional phrases are most effective for contrasting points in an essay?
